breathe.title: Breathe with a square
breathe.description: Box breathing: in, hold, out, hold, four counts each. Follow the dot around the square.
breathe.intro: Follow the dot around the square. Breathe in along the first side, hold along the top, breathe out down the side, hold along the bottom.
breathe.vibrate: Gentle vibration when the step changes

ground.title: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding
ground.description: A quick way back to the room: notice five things you can see, four you can feel, three you can hear, two you can smell, one you can taste.
ground.intro: One step at a time. Look around and notice. There is no right answer.
ground.doneText: Take one more slow breath. You can do it again any time.
